entities.name: Cbz-protected bicyclic amine
observations: Decoded substrate SMILES: CS(=O)(=O)N1CC2COCC(C1)N2C(=O)OCc1ccccc1; contains an N-Cbz carbamate.

entities.name: Free bicyclic amine
observations: Hydrogenolysis product SMILES: CS(=O)(=O)N1CC2COCC(C1)N2; reported ORD yield 78% with Pd/C, H2, and MeOH.
Cbz group is removed while methylsulfonamide and bicyclic scaffold are retained.
